programme.desc: A successful man tries to reconnect with his old teacher only to find out that she is in deep trouble. Upon learning this, he decides to do everything he can to save her.

programme.title: Johny I Love You

programme.title: Chori Mera Kaam
programme.desc: Two petty thieves, Raja and Balu, take refuge in Anjali's house while escaping from the police. When Raja learns about Anjali's misery, he decides to help her.

programme.title: Main Intequam Loonga
programme.desc: Kumar learns that his father, a national level boxing champion, was killed when he refused to lose a fight. He vows to annihilate his father's killers, unaware that he may face tragic consequences.

programme.title: Khakee: The Real Police
programme.desc: When a drug lord ransoms police officer Diwakar's son for a bag of cocaine, he has no choice but to steal it from police headquarters. However, this raises the suspicions of his colleague Mallika.

programme.title: Ek Se Bure Do
programme.desc: Jagat, a gangster, hires Toti and Tony to steal a treasure map. But they provide him with a fake copy of the map and reserve the original. When Jagat learns about it, he plans to teach them a lesson.

programme.title: Jigri Dost

programme.title: Jagan

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Falak
programme.desc: Ramnath, a watchman, is killed while stopping his corrupt bosses from committing a crime. Years later, his sons decide to exact revenge against his murderers.

programme.title: Samay-when the time strikes

programme.title: Kahani Kismat Ki
programme.desc: A reformed man tries to make an honest living for himself and his family after his jail term. His life takes an ugly turn when a woman claims him to be her husband and he is also framed for murder.

programme.desc: Three fraudsters trick a rich elderly woman, Sulakshana, who is desperately looking for her long-lost grandchild, in order to acquire her estate and property.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Taekwondo Inspires Changes in Kids
programme.desc: A Brazilian couple who moved to Shiga Prefecture in Japan teach taekwondo to children - their efforts are helping kids develop more than just athletically.

programme.title: Vanishing Alpine Meadows
programme.desc: The ecosystem in Hokkaido's Taisetsu Mountains is changing dramatically - alpine plants have vanished due to global warming which has created a crisis for rare animals that depend on them to survive.

programme.title: Design Museum Japan
programme.desc: Shiga / Nagayama Yuko (architect). For 400 years, a group of stonemasons have been building walls using natural stone. Nagayama learns how a stone's qualities are assessed and utilised.

programme.title: The Factory Wonders
programme.desc: This time, we explore a Nanbu ironware factory blending traditional moulds and casting techniques with modern design. See masterful skills and a president's passion for ironware reimagined for today.

programme.title: Time-Lapse Japan
programme.desc: Cape Ashizuri is marked by rugged cliffs and peculiar rocks. A strong current off its coast has been the cause of many accidents. Enjoy the scenery at the cape, a place of worship, in time-lapse.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: The Seasons of Yamato

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon invents a device that can override the need to sleep in 'Dr. Sleep', then in 'Davey Boy', Alvin zaps Dave with a youth ray, turning him into an irresponsible teen. (S5, ep 6)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin decides to be a hero with disastrous results in 'Fire Safety', then in 'Castle Catstrophe', Cheesy and Alvin cause an accident at a historic castle. (S5, ep 12)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin takes Theodore's drums, so Theodore mimics him in 'Little Drummer Boy', then in 'Special Ingredient, Alvin sabotages Theodore's pancakes. (S5, ep 18)

programme.desc: The Munks help a world-famous runner in 'Run Aimee Run', then in 'Theo vs Simon', Theodore embarks on a quest to find one thing he can do better than Simon, but it won't be so easy. (S5, ep 24)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Jeanette is proclaimed a fashion trendsetter by Brittany's icon in 'She's Got Style', then in 'Super Heroes', Theodore thinks he's a real superhero, and Alvin and Simon can't convince him. (S1, ep 19)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: A new boy band tries to steal the spotlight in 'We're the Chipmunks', then in 'Save the Dance', the Principal gives Alvin & Derek an ultimatum - if they fight, the dance will be cancelled. (S2, ep 17)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore gives Dave an ugly handmade vest in 'The Gift', and then in 'Theo Knows Best', when Theodore finds a winning lottery ticket, everyone has ideas on how the money should be spent. (S3, ep 7)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin and Brittany face a spooky mystery in 'School Alone', then in 'It Came From Outer Space', Alvin's fake meteor causes chaos. (S3, ep 13)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Miss Miller gets robbed in 'The Great Chipmunk Detective', and in 'Guitar Hero', Alvin begrudgingly agrees to teach Miss Smith guitar, but she won't reveal why she needs to learn. (S3, ep 25)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin talks Dave into a poor scheme in 'Tour Bus', then in 'Game Show', Alvin signs the Chipmunks up for a game show that forces losing contestants to perform dangerous stunts. (S4, ep 7)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Derek plans a wild party at Alvin's house in 'Animal House Party', then in 'Dr. Zap vs Electroboy', Theodore is hit by lightning and believes he's like his comic book hero. (S4, ep 17)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave gets bad reviews on the internet in 'You Troll', then in 'Life of the Party', The Chipmunks along with Kevin and Cheesy decide to crash BoCarter's party after not being invited. (S4, ep 22)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin's too short for a new amusement park ride in 'U-Fly', then in 'Yeti or Not', Alvin convinces Theodore there's a Yeti nearby, making life miserable for the rest of the family. (S5, ep 3)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Miss Croner has a disagreement with Miss Miller in 'Gone Gal', and in 'Time Traveller's Party', Simon tells Alvin time travel is impossible, until a man from the future shows up at home. (S5, ep 8)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin takes Simon's place on a camping trip in 'Excavation Vacation', and in 'Trophy Dad', The Chipmunks suspect Dave is lying about the various awards he's won. (S5, ep 14)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theo's art project gains fans but then gets hacked in 'Mr. Lou', then in 'Love Song', Simon panics when Dave's song reveals his poem. (S5, ep 20)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin is sure that Theo has been kidnapped in 'A is for Alien', then in 'Jeanette Enchanted', The Chipmunks and Chipettes join forces to offer Jeanette a magical fairy-tale birthday! (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin accidentally clones himself in 'Double Trouble', then in 'Liar Liar', Alvin tells a small lie that quickly turns into a huge disaster, dragging everyone into his tangled web. (S2, ep 10)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin agrees not to speak for 24 hours in 'Spoiler-Itis', then in 'Something's Fishy', when Alvin and Simon think Theodore's pet goldfish has died, they try to replace it before he notices. (S3, ep 4)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The boys accidently break Dave's new flat screen TV in 'The Fugitives', and in 'Sherlock Chipmunk', Jeanette and Eleanor act as Sherlock Holmes and Watson when Theodore's teddy disappears. (S3, ep 10)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon's plant experiment creates a growing monster in 'A Rose By Another Name', then in 'Queen Bee', Brittany admires bees after living as one. (S3, ep 20)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore gets roped into doing Alvin's job in 'Adventures in Babysitting', then in 'Alvin's Assistant', Kevin agrees to be Alvin's assistant but ends up running errands instead. (S4, ep 3)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Chipmunks and Chipettes play in a dodgeball tournament in 'Munk Vs Machine', then in 'Shack Magic', The Chipmunks find a shack that magically fills with toys and games, but is it magic? (S4, ep 9)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Jeanette and the Chipmunks rescue a chimpanzee in 'Chimpmania', then in 'Dad Jokes', Dave will be hosting an auction where he'll have to tell jokes, but will Alvin tell him he's not funny? (S4, ep 19)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Chipettes fall in love with a cute little mouse in 'Of Mice and Munks', and in 'Simon Saves the World', Simon's new invention creates a time loop and changing gravity inside the house. (S4, ep 24)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Chipmunks don't want to perform in the school play in 'The Curse of MacBeth', then in 'Zeela The Great', Simon's robot Geizmo becomes jealous of Jeanette's robot Zeela. (S5, ep 5)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin pretends to write a broadway show in 'Writer's Blocked', and in 'Jinxed!', after Theodore sees Alvin accidentally ruin Dave's computer, Alvin jinxes Theodore so he can't tell on him. (S5, ep 11)

programme.title: A Lifetime Ago with The Baim Collection
programme.desc: Enchanted Cities. 1957. Narrated by Kenneth Macleod. A tour of the beautiful Italian cities of Florence and Venice.

programme.title: The Rogues
programme.desc: A Daring Step Backwards. 1965. Gig Young, David Niven and Charles Boyer are The Rogues, members of two related families of international forgers and conmen. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Traitor. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Archie Duncan. King John fails to gather money to release Richard, some Lords raise the money. Robin must secretly get it out the country. [S]

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Mistress Higgins' Treasure. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Adrienne Corri & Edwin Richfield. Whilst smuggling tools to desperate farmers, Dan meets a mysterious woman at sea who has a tale to tell. [S]

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: Grounded. 1961. Stars David Graham & George Murcell. The Supercar project has moved to England for the installation of new control circuits, but a disgruntled employee steals the units. [S]

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Broken Honeymoon. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Nanette Newman & Conrad Phillips. Helen and Clive Parker's honeymoon in the jungle turns into a nightmare when she is attacked by a Leopard. [S]

programme.title: Operation Stogie
programme.desc: 1959. Comedy. Director: Ernest Morris. Stars John Hewer, Anton Rodgers & Susan Stephen. Two cadets are set an outrageous and wacky initiation test to prove their suitability for officer training. [S]

programme.title: Who Killed the Cat?
programme.desc: 1966. Drama. Directed by Montgomery Tully. Stars: Mary Merrall, Ellen Pollock, Mervyn Johns. A widow persecutes three old ladies, but fate takes its revenge. [S]

programme.title: Mad Mel and Mister Gibson
programme.desc: 2021. The rise, fall and resurrection of Mel Gibson, one of the most successful but also controversial Hollywood stars. From Mad Max to The Passion of the Christ, from Lethal Weapon to Braveheart.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Pursuit. 1974. Stars Jack Watson, David Jackson & Gareth Armstrong. An old man is viciously assaulted on his doorstep, and Render and Braithwaite are called out to assist. [S]

programme.title: The Dark Light
programme.desc: 1951. Thriller. Director: Vernon Sewell. Stars Albert Lieven, David Greene & Norman MacOwen. The crew of a lighthouse bring a boat to safety, unaware that it carries a gang of robbers on the run. [S]

programme.title: Look At Life Roses All The Way
programme.desc: 1960. A look at the rose, which has been England's national emblem for more than 400 years and an increasingly popular flower within millions of gardens.

programme.title: Richard the Lionheart
programme.desc: The Vision Fades. 1963. Stars Dermot Walsh, Jeremy Bisley & Roger Bizley. Victory close and Jerusalem in sight, Richard readies for battle but realises his allies are undependable. [S]

programme.title: Hell Drivers
programme.desc: 1957. Drama. Director C. Raker Endfield. Stars Stanley Baker, David McCallum, Sid James and Sean Connery. Tom signs up as a 'Hell Driver', but the death-trap roads are the least of his problems. [S]

programme.title: Window to the Sky 1967
programme.desc: 1967. A fascinating short film about the dangers of air pollution including the effect that the London smog has had on the area.

programme.title: That's My Boy
programme.desc: Live as Family. 1981. Stars Mollie Sugden, Christopher Blake & Jennifer Lonsdale. Ida Willis takes a job as housekeeper. Dr Robert Price wants to fire Ida, until he finds out who she really is. [S]

programme.title: Blanche Fury
programme.desc: 1948. Crime. Director: Marc Allegret, Stars Valerie Hobson, Stewart Granger & Michael Gough. Penniless governess Blanche Fullerton takes a job at the estate of her rich relations, the Fury family. [S]

programme.title: The History of Shippams

programme.title: The Footage Detectives

programme.title: Maigret

programme.title: Mort D'un Pourri

programme.title: Svengali

programme.title: Kent in the 1970s - Glimpses

programme.title: The Veil

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E

programme.title: The Happiness of Three Women

programme.title: Juggernaut (1936)

programme.title: The Big Bluff

programme.title: The Better Milk Story

programme.title: Look At Life Everything Stops For Tea

programme.title: Jassy
